short_description: Hemispherical 15/70 film projection. 180° horizontal × 125° vertical FOV, 80–86% hemisphere coverage. Total peripheral immersion — not a conventional cinema experience.

default_projection.effective_resolution_label: ~8.8K–11.7K scan-equivalent projected onto 80–86% hemisphere; center pixel density higher than periphery due to fisheye lens mapping
default_projection.contrast_notes: Photochemical contrast ~4,500:1. 15kW xenon short-arc lamp. Brightness per unit area is lower than flat screens due to projection over ~800–1,000 m² dome surface.
default_projection.color_gamut: Photochemical (very wide, not specifiable as % DCI-P3)

known_limitations: Not a conventional cinema — requires dome-mastered content for optimal immersion; standard flat IMAX films appear distorted via fisheye projection
PPD lower per degree than flat GT screens (~23 PPD vs ~77) — resolution spread over 180° FOV rather than ~55°
Non-linear pixel density from fisheye lens: center sharpest, extreme periphery softer
Institutional venues primarily; not part of commercial multiplex IMAX network
